scripts.build:html: node scripts/extract-critical-css.js && node scripts/build-html.js && npx prettier --write dist/index.html
scripts.build:assets: cp assets/favicon.svg assets/robots.txt assets/sitemap.xml dist/ && mkdir -p dist/vendor/fontawesome/css dist/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts && cp vendor/fontawesome/css/all.min.css dist/vendor/fontawesome/css/ && cp vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2 vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/fa-brands-400.woff2 dist/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/ && cp -r images dist/images && npx svgo dist/favicon.svg --quiet
scripts.dev: SOURCEMAPS=1 npm run build && node scripts/dev-server.js
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
